Wedding DJ | Songs Planner | Ceremony Reception > San Francisco Bay Area CA

Give me a Call British DJ Chris – 1-415-350-5474

HERE IS JUST A SAMPLE OF THE LAYOUT FOR BAY AREA WEDDINGS TO HELP YOU WITH YOUR SPECIAL DAY AND GIVE SOME IDEAS !

(Please note each wedding is unique and we play customised music for the types of music the Bride & Groom requests.) 
Visit the Wedding Store 

HERES SOME IDEAS OF HOW TO PLAN YOUR WEDDING

This is a sample timeline for an event:

1      First Dance: ‘Unchained Melody’ – Righteous Brothers
2 .    Father/Daughter Dance – Unforgettable
3 .    Mother/ Son – Mama Boyz II Men
4.     Bridal Party Dance – We are family.
5      Garter toss: ‘Legs’ – ZZ Top
6      Bouquet toss: Like a Virgin — Madonna
7      Cake Cutting – Average White Band – Cut The Cake / Games: mission impossible, etc
8 .     Guests Dance
9.      Last Dance

TimeLine: for DJ 5:15pm – 11:15pm (at Wedding Location : Penthouse Suite.)
5.15pm – 6.30pm Ceremony – Wedding Party March – Processional – Recessional.
6:30pm – 7:00pm – Guests entering the reception room Cocktail Music (Grand Entrance) Names Read From A list.
7:00pm – 8:00pm – Arrival Of Wedding Party – Dinner served – Wedding Type Jazz
8:00pm – 8:15pm – Toast (by best man : maid of honor)
8:15pm – 8.25pm – Slide show
8:25pm – 8:40 pm – First dance, Dance with Parents Father/Daughter, Mother/Son, Bridal Party Dance,
8:40pm – 9:05pm – Garter toss, Bouquet toss,
9:05pm – 9:15pm – Cake serving – Bride & Groom, bride groom to parents
9:15pm – 11:10pm – Guests dance.Dance Music.
11.10pm – 11.15pm – Last Dance
____________________________________________________________________

Optional: Table Toasts, Also Games (During cake or dinner) other games (involving Bride And Groom and some guests)- Sometimes Games while the cake is being served so that the guests are not starting to go home If Needed.
after the cake cutting)

*Stevie Wonder – Signed, Sealed & Delivered

ACTIVITIES AND GAMES
1. *Sing part of a song, give a toast, or tell a story to get the bride and groom to kiss
2. *Sing part of a song to be allowed to go to the buffet table
3. *Blindfold the guy who caught garter before he removes the garter from the leg of the lady who caught the bouquet
4. *Married couples dance and we find out who has been married the longest at the reception
5. *Blindfold the bride and she guesses which arm muscle belongs to the groom
6. *Blindfold the groom and he feels hands or calves and guesses which one belongs to the bride
7. *The bride moves an egg through the grooms pants
8. *The bride and groom eat something and come together for a kiss
9. *The groom pays the bride a compliment for each step he takes toward her
10. *The bride is blindfolded and has to find the money on the groom
11. *Guests have to do what the bride and groom say to get a personal item back
12. *”Ex-boyfriends” and “ex-girlfriends” return the “keys” to the bride and groom’s apartments
13. *Musical chairs
14. *The groom guesses which lipstick mark belongs to the bride
15. *The groom is blindfolded and has to walk without knocking down the wine bottles
16. *The bride has to catch the cherry
17. *Guests need to get pencils, which are hanging on strings behind them, in the bottles 
18. * whos been married the longest dance, oldest married couple gets to give advice to bride & groom for a happy marriage.
